say:1:1130811001:0.text: After Boss Ferranc's defeat, the Claws broke apart.
say:1:1130811001:0.source_cn: 弗兰克首领被击败后，大家散的散，逃的逃。
say:1:1130811001:0.male: After Boss Ferranc's defeat, the Claws broke apart.
say:1:1130811001:0.female: After Boss Ferranc's defeat, the Claws broke apart.

say:2:1130811002:0.text: I heard many caravans had arrived at Alkali. I'd love to visit the market there.
say:2:1130811002:0.source_cn: 听说咸水镇里来了不少商队，还办起了集市，我想去那儿看看。
say:2:1130811002:0.male: I heard many caravans had arrived at Alkali. I'd love to visit the market there.
say:2:1130811002:0.female: I heard many caravans had arrived at Alkali. I'd love to visit the market there.

say:3:1130811003:1.text: My friends told me many interesting stories. Some goods those caravans brought from afar are things I've never laid eyes on before.
say:3:1130811003:1.source_cn: 之前听同伴们讲了很多有趣的事，商队里运载的远方的货物，...
say:3:1130811003:1.male: My friends told me many interesting stories. Some goods those caravans brought from afar are things I've never laid eyes on before.
say:3:1130811003:1.female: My friends told me many interesting stories. Some goods those caravans brought from afar are things I've never laid eyes on before.

say:4:1130811004:1.text: If I could land a job in a caravan, I'd be able to see more of the world.
say:4:1130811004:1.source_cn: 如果我能在商队里找到一份工作，以后就能跟商队一起去很多...
say:4:1130811004:1.male: If I could land a job in a caravan, I'd be able to see more of the world.
say:4:1130811004:1.female: If I could land a job in a caravan, I'd be able to see more of the world.

say:5:1130811005:1.text: Who knows? I'd love to leave this hopeless place.
say:5:1130811005:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢，我真的很想离开这个没有希望的地方。
say:5:1130811005:1.male: Who knows? I'd love to leave this hopeless place.
say:5:1130811005:1.female: Who knows? I'd love to leave this hopeless place.
